episodes.name: You Can Go Home Again
episodes.overview: On the way home from a summer road trip, Cory agrees to a final pit stop--not knowing Eric intends to make it a permanent one because he's "not ready for the summer to end."

episodes.name: Hair Today, Goon Tomorrow
episodes.overview: As Cory is feeling insecure about his hair, Topanga shows him that appearance is meaningless, and she proves so by cutting off some of her own locks, a decision she quickly regrets.

episodes.name: I Ain't Gonna Spray Lettuce No More
episodes.overview: After quitting his job at the grocer's, Alan shops for a new career, but ends up at a convenience store, where Amy fears he'll be unhappy.

episodes.name: Fishing for Virna
episodes.overview: Shawn's mom is back but won't go home until she is sure they can be a good family--something Shawn and his dad must accomplish on their own.

episodes.name: Shallow Boy
episodes.overview: Eric aggravates an offbeat guitar player when he tells her to take her tunes and her sunny demeanor elsewhere.

episodes.name: Janitor Dad
episodes.overview: Shawn's life is a mess when his dad takes a job as a school janitor, so Mr. Feeny offers to let him decide his father's career fate.

episodes.name: Singled Out
episodes.overview: Eric tires of his dating pool, so he tries to get a date on "Singled Out"--but the host does little to help him out.

episodes.name: Dangerous Secret
episodes.overview: Shawn insists things aren't what they seem when Cory catches him with a girl, but Cory won't buy it, and tries to play catch-up by getting intimate with Topanga.

episodes.name: Sixteen Candles and 400-lb. Men
episodes.overview: Cory agrees to go to a wrestling match with a buddy on the same night as Topanga's Sweet 16 party.

episodes.name: Turkey Day
episodes.overview: Cory and Shawn feel their families should spend Thanksgiving together, but everyone else thinks it's a foul idea.

episodes.name: An Affair to Forget
episodes.overview: After Shawn's dumped by a girl, Cory cheers him by insulting her; but when she learns what he said, she reconciles with Shawn and forbids him to see Cory.

episodes.name: Easy Street
episodes.overview: When Cory discovers the men he's working for are in the mob, he quits--and Shawn takes his place.

episodes.name: B & B's B'n B
episodes.overview: When Mr. Feeny goes on a weekend trip, Shawn turns the teacher's house into a bed-and-breakfast for a class project.

episodes.name: Wheels
episodes.overview: It's Cory's 16th birthday and he can't wait to get his license and take a road trip. But his dad has other plans: a birthday dinner with the family.

episodes.name: Chick Like Me
episodes.overview: Shawn thinks Cory's newspaper column is a drag, so he tells Cory to spice things up by posing as a girl and writing about the stunt. But it's Shawn who ends up in a dress.

episodes.name: A Long Walk to Pittsburgh (Part 1)
episodes.overview: Eric sees Shawn kiss Topanga and tells Cory about the incident. But the bad news is the peck was for good reason: Topanga's moving.

episodes.name: A Long Walk to Pittsburgh (Part 2)
episodes.overview: Just as crestfallen Cory gives up hope of seeing Topanga again, she shows up.

episodes.name: Uncle Daddy
episodes.overview: When Eric learns his girlfriend has a son, he's confident he can handle the responsibility--but too scared to tell his parents about it.

episodes.name: Quiz Show
episodes.overview: Cory, Shawn and Topanga fail miserably on a quiz show, but they're so popular with viewers that the producer makes the questions easier.

episodes.name: Security Guy
episodes.overview: Eric blames Amy, not Alan, for getting fired; and when they pressure him to go to college, he gets a job as a security guard and moves out.

episodes.name: Cult Fiction
episodes.overview: Feeling lost and alone, Shawn starts spending time with a group of people that he defensively describes as "not a cult."

episodes.name: Learning to Fly
episodes.overview: Cory's in a jam when a coed makes a pass at him while he's visiting a college.
